description: Flat glass card of labelled detail rows for the transaction-detail screen: Note, Date, Source (icon+word+color badge), Added-by (partner glyph), and Recurring. Rows are divider-separated; empty/unknown rows are omitted, not shown blank.

note.description: Free-text note. Row omitted when empty. Value wraps freely (no line cap).

date.description: ISO 8601 timestamp; formatted 'Tue, Jun 17 2026 · 2:14 PM'. Row shows 'Date unavailable' (textMuted) when absent.

bankName.description: Linked institution name, e.g. 'Chase'. Shown only when source==='bank'.

accountLast4.description: Masked account tail, e.g. '4021'. Rendered as '••4021'.

actorGlyph.description: { glyph: '◑'|'◐', color: string, name: string } | null. Null for shared/unknown/solo → 'Added by' row omitted.

frequency.description: 'one-time'|'weekly'|'biweekly'|'monthly'. Recurring row shown only when set and !== 'one-time'.

bank.note: tint on icon + 'linked' only; body stays colors.text

accessibility.role: list of static text rows (or button when a row deep-links, e.g. Source → linked account)
accessibility.label: per row: '{label}, {spoken value}.' e.g. 'Source, from Chase, linked account.'
accessibility.colorIndependence: source and partner conveyed by icon/glyph + word + color together
